_why: Hunter M4 (Nov 26): how Furfur Kemp talks, in the same dialogue box as the voices (voice_box.gd reads name and colour here). He is NOT an equippable voice: he never joins the profile's voices list. Lines are placeholders until Duff signs off the writing.
name: FURFUR KEMP

invade: You left a blood trail from the church to your front door. Rude not to visit.
Price wants you broken. I want the overtime.
knockdown: Stay down. I bill by the hour.
Up again? Your mother was stubborn too.
chained: Chains. Cute. I've been bound by better lawyers.
Fine. I'll stay. Someone has to watch you fail.
home: Back already? Did they at least tip?
I hear Price in the walls. He says you're doing great. He lies too.
after_fail: Limping again. You hunt like a man paying off someone else's debt.
Oh, it went badly. Come on. You know where I am.
vent: Ha. There it is. Do it again, and this time turn your hips.
That one I felt. You're learning from the wrong teacher.
